verdicts.reason: A stacks the NEW VIDEO badge above the logo, offset to the right, so it floats loose and the brand mark loses its top-left anchor. Its shoe is also shrunk to sit inside the circle, which weakens the hero. B keeps the original's logo-left, badge-right top row and keeps the sole breaking past the circle as in the original. Its flaws are tight margins: about 18px on the left, 'marathons' nearly reaches the right edge, and 'Full review inside' sits close to the bottom.
